headings: Our Clinical Results and Economic Evidence
paragraphs: We provide software and artificial intelligence ("AI") designed to deliver a more accurate and clinically effective non-invasive solution for diagnosing and managing coronary artery disease ("CAD"), a leading cause of death worldwide. As of December 31, 2025, our Heartflow Platform has been used to assess CAD in more than 600,000 patients, including 219,000 in 2025 alone. We believe that we are the most widely adopted AI-powered test for CAD. Our novel platform leverages AI and advanced computational fluid dynamics to create a personalized 3D model of a patient's heart from a single coronary computed tomography angiography ("CCTA"), a specialized type of scan that provides detailed images of the heart's arteries. Our Heartflow Platform delivers actionable insights on blood flow, stenosis, plaque volume and plaque composition thereby overcoming the limitations of traditional non-invasive imaging tests which rely on indirect measures of coronary disease and lead to higher false negative and false positive rates, as demonstrated by our PRECISE trial. We believe the differentiated accuracy and clinical utility of our Heartflow Platform, along with its ability to enhance workflows, will continue to support our growth and advance the "CCTA + Heartflow" pathway as the definitive standard for the non-invasive diagnosis and management of CAD.

Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide, with CAD being the most lethal form. CAD occurs when plaque—a buildup of cholesterol, fat, calcium and other substances—accumulates on the walls of the coronary arteries, restricting blood flow and increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke. This condition is responsible for half of all cardiovascular-related deaths globally. In the United States alone, the Centers for Disease Control ("CDC") estimates that approximately 805,000 people suffer a heart attack each year. Despite significant advancements in therapeutic and interventional treatments, CAD remains a leading cause of death globally because healthcare systems generally lack scalable methods to efficiently detect, diagnose and quantify CAD at a personalized level.

CCTA has emerged as a leading non-invasive imaging method for evaluating CAD, offering direct and detailed visualization of the coronary arteries. Unlike traditional stress-based non-invasive tests ("NITs"), CCTA enables physicians to identify the presence and extent of coronary blockage. As a result, CCTA has become the preferred first-line test for patients with suspected CAD, as evidenced by the AHA and ACC guidelines elevating CCTA to Class 1, Level A. However, while CCTA provides superior anatomical imaging, it does not independently quantify the severity of CAD, assess blood flow limitations, or characterize plaque composition—critical factors for determining the most appropriate, personalized course of treatment for a patient.

Our Heartflow Platform builds upon the well-established strengths of CCTA by going beyond its limitations and providing new quantified insights and compelling visualizations of data. By applying our advanced AI-powered technology to a single CCTA scan, we generate a precise, patient-specific analysis that quantifies blood flow, measures plaque burden, and characterizes plaque composition—at every point in the major coronary arteries.

Heartflow enhances CCTA, the most advanced non-invasive imaging modality for assessing CAD, with AI-powered analysis to deliver more accurate and clinically actionable insights for diagnosing and managing CAD. The Heartflow Platform applies deep learning, an advanced form of AI, and computational fluid dynamics to CCTA images to create a personalized 3D model of a patient's heart based on a single CCTA image. This model provides actionable insights into blood flow, stenosis, plaque volume and plaque composition allowing precise diagnosis, risk stratification, and treatment planning – without the need for an invasive procedure.

We designed our AI-powered software platform to be highly scalable, seamlessly integrate into existing physician workflows for diagnosing CAD, and improve as we ingest more data over time. By leveraging AI to process massive volumes of cases and a "human-in-the loop" quality control process, where learnings are fed back into our algorithms to improve their performance and efficiency, we have scaled our platform to deliver accurate, timely results to benefit physicians and patients alike. Our cloud-based technology has enabled us to rapidly scale to an installed base of more than 1,465 accounts in the United States as of December 31, 2025. We have also built a substantial and growing data asset that has driven refinement of our algorithms for over 10 years and as of

December 31, 2025, we have analyzed and annotated more than 160 million annotated CCTA images. Additionally, through our bi-directional data sharing relationship with our customers we ensure platform enhancements, delivering immediate and tangible benefits through new features, workflow efficiencies, and improved performance.

When a patient presents with symptoms of CAD and their physician follows the AHA and ACC Class 1, Level A chest pain guidelines by referring the patient for a CCTA, the patient will undergo standard CCTA imaging at the relevant hospital or outpatient facility. At Heartflow-enabled accounts, CCTA images are securely transmitted directly to our cloud-based platform through our embedded software in the hospital or outpatient imaging center. Leveraging proprietary AI and advanced computational fluid dynamics, we create a personalized, 3D digital model of the patient's coronary arteries, unlocking critical insights beyond what is visible on standard imaging.

Our Heartflow Platform seamlessly integrates into our customer workflows, providing clinically actionable insights directly to the account, which we believe is sufficient for the workflows of our customers. We deliver the Heartflow RoadMap Analysis automatically to the imaging cardiologist or radiologist for every acceptable CCTA patient at our accounts to help drive more efficient CCTA interpretation, workflows and revascularization strategies. In conjunction with the Heartflow RoadMap Analysis, we also provide physicians with a case list that catalogs all their CCTAs and identifies the cases where our Heartflow FFRCT Analysis, Heartflow Plaque Analysis or both would enable them to accurately diagnose clinically significant CAD and plan treatment. With a single click, Physicians can access these analyses on-demand, and we bill the account directly for each product selected. Because Heartflow FFRCT Analysis and Heartflow Plaque Analysis have distinct clinical indications and dedicated billing codes, our workflow helps ensure physicians can order the most appropriate analyses for each patient, supporting both high-quality care and efficient reimbursement processes.

To date, we have developed three software products (with a fourth product expected to launch in the second quarter of 2026) under the Heartflow Platform that provide physicians with the critical insights needed to effectively diagnose and manage CAD:

Heartflow RoadMap Analysis: The Heartflow RoadMap Analysis provides a highly intuitive anatomic visualization of the patient's coronary anatomy based on CCTA images. It rapidly orients the imaging physician to clinically relevant areas of the patient anatomy and provides a preview of what they will review in the native CCTA images to aid the physician in accurately, efficiently and consistently identifying stenosis in the coronary arteries. Heartflow RoadMap Analysis supports more efficient radiology workflow, improving CCTA read times by 25% and increasing consistency between reviewing physicians by approximately 40%, as demonstrated in our SMART-CT study. Physicians use Heartflow Roadmap Analysis as a first-line assessment tool along with CCTA interpretation to determine whether to order our more detailed Heartflow FFRCT Analysis or Heartflow Plaque Analysis reports. The Heartflow RoadMap Analysis was cleared by the FDA in October 2022, and we began providing it to our customers in the second quarter of 2023. We generally provide Heartflow RoadMap Analysis to accounts as an integrated feature to enhance the efficiency and consistency of their CCTA programs, and it is not a stand-alone product. We believe the efficiency that Heartflow RoadMap Analysis provides our customers has resulted in enhanced customer loyalty and retention.

Heartflow FFRCT Analysis: Our flagship product, Heartflow FFRCT Analysis, consists of a patient-specific, interactive, 3D anatomical reconstruction of the coronary anatomy that calculates blood flow and identifies clinically significant CAD to determine the need for intervention, which is CAD with a fractional flow reserve ("FFR") value of 0.80 or below, at every point in the major coronary arteries. FFR measures the severity of blood flow restriction in the coronary arteries on a scale of 1.0 (no restriction) to 0.0 (complete blockage) by assessing pressure differences across a stenosis during induced stress, guiding decisions on whether a patient requires invasive revascularization.

The model is color-coded along vessel length, indicating Heartflow FFRCT Analysis values which assist the physician in rapidly and precisely assessing blood flow through the coronary arteries. Our Heartflow FFRCT Analysis has the highest diagnostic accuracy for a non-invasive CAD test and has demonstrated a high level of concordance to invasive FFR, as seen in our PRECISE, NXT and PACIFIC trials. Our product can measure the FFR value and determine whether a lesion is clinically significant – a "clinically significant lesion" means an FFR value of 0.80 or below. Because FFR values are the guideline directed measure to determine the need for invasive revascularization, this data offers a more clinically accurate, non-invasive basis for determining the need for interventional treatment.

Current AHA and ACC guidelines support CCTA + Heartflow FFRCT Analysis as a more efficient care pathway. The guidelines designate CCTA as a Class 1, Level A test for CAD in certain patients with stable or acute chest pain and no known CAD, with our Heartflow FFRCT Analysis given a Class 2a, Level B recognition to help physicians guide patient treatment decisions. This CCTA + Heartflow FFRCT Analysis pathway enables physicians to identify lesions that require revascularization in less than two hours, and guidelines recommend patients with positive Heartflow FFRCT Analysis findings be sent directly to the cardiac catheterization lab for possible treatment. Comparatively, AHA and ACC guidelines provide stress-based testing a Class 1, Level B recommendation, suggesting patients with suspected CAD and positive stress-based test findings first initiate guideline directed medical therapy. Only if symptoms are not resolved by medical therapy, which can last weeks or months, are patients then sent to the cardiac catheterization lab.

headings: Risks Related to Our Business and Industry
We have incurred significant net losses since our inception, we expect to incur additional substantial losses in the foreseeable future and we may not be able to achieve or sustain profitability.

If healthcare providers are unwilling to change their standard practice regarding the evaluation of CAD, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects will be adversely affected.
We face risks associated with a concentrated customer base.
The size and expected growth of our addressable market may be smaller than we estimate.
We may not be successful in updating or otherwise enhancing the Heartflow Platform.
We face risks associated with our use and development of AI models, which may result in operational challenges, legal liability, reputational concerns and competitive risks.
If we fail to properly manage our future growth, our business could suffer.
Our business could be disrupted by catastrophic events.

paragraphs: Investing in our common stock involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks and uncertainties described below, as well as the other information in this Annual Report, including our consolidated financial statements and the related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations," before deciding whether to invest in, hold or sell our common stock. The occurrence of any of the events or developments described below could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. In such an event, the market price of our common stock could decline, and you may lose all or part of your investment. Additional risks and uncertainties not presently known to us or that we currently believe are not material may also impair our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects. Please also see the section titled "Special Note Regarding Forward-Looking Statements."

The following risks and uncertainties included in this subsection are among the most significant we face and are qualified in their entirety by reference to all of the risk factors as further described in this Item 1A.
•We have incurred significant net losses since our inception, we expect to incur additional substantial losses in the foreseeable future and we may not be able to achieve or sustain profitability.

•Our revenue is currently generated almost entirely from the sales of only one product, Heartflow FFRCT Analysis, and we are therefore highly dependent on the success of this product, which makes it difficult to evaluate our current business, predict our future prospects and forecast our financial performance and any growth.

•If healthcare providers are unwilling to change their standard practice regarding the evaluation of CAD, our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects will be adversely affected.

•If third-party payors, including government payors, do not cover and provide adequate reimbursement for the Heartflow Platform, or if existing payment amounts are reduced or coding policies change, adoption of the Heartflow Platform by healthcare providers may be negatively impacted, and our business, financial condition, results of operations and prospects will be adversely affected.

•Heartflow RoadMap Analysis offers a highly intuitive anatomic visualization of the coronary arteries, helping physicians quickly identify clinically relevant areas to focus their review. We provide Heartflow RoadMap Analysis to accounts as an integrated feature to enhance the efficiency of their CCTA program, and it is not a stand-alone product.

•Heartflow FFRCT Analysis calculates blood flow and pinpoints clinically significant CAD, which is CAD with a fractional flow reserve ("FFR") value of 0.80 or below, at every point in the major coronary arteries. FFR measures the severity of blood flow restriction in the coronary arteries on a scale of 1.0 (no restriction) to 0.0 (complete blockage) by assessing pressure differences across a stenosis during induced stress, guiding decisions on whether a patient requires invasive revascularization.
•Heartflow Plaque Analysis provides a comprehensive assessment of coronary plaque, enabling optimized medical treatment strategies.

•Heartflow PCI Navigator, which we expect to launch in the second quarter of 2026, will provide advanced visualization and clinical insights to optimize revascularization strategies, guide device selection, enhance procedural efficiency, and improve patient care. We plan to provide Heartflow PCI Navigator to accounts as an integrated feature to enhance procedural efficiency, not as a stand-alone product.

We anticipate launching Plaque Tracker, our fifth product, in 2027. Plaque Tracker will enable longitudinal plaque analysis of sequential CCTAs to measure the efficacy of medical therapy based on plaque regression.

The Heartflow Platform has an existing commercial presence and regulatory approval in the United States, United Kingdom, European Union, and Japan. Additionally, some or all of our platform have received medical device licensing or approvals in

Canada, Australia, Israel, Saudi Arabia and United Arab Emirates and Bahrain. We have developed a highly scalable, capital efficient commercial model that combines Territory Sales Managers ("TSMs") who drive new account adoption with Territory Account Managers ("TAMs") who focus on increasing utilization by educating referring physicians. Our commercial team does not cover cases or otherwise spend time in an operating room or lab setting, which enables them to focus solely on driving commercial adoption and educational activities. We also have small, direct commercial teams in our international markets. In the future, we may expand our international presence beyond these markets.

Our technology is simple and intuitive and does not require the purchase of any capital equipment. Our onboarding process seamlessly integrates the Heartflow Platform into the customer's daily workflow. These unique attributes of our business model afford our commercial organization a differentiated level of efficiency and scalability.

We have experienced considerable revenue growth since we began commercializing the Heartflow Platform in 2015, driven primarily by growth in our account base and increasing test volumes at accounts in our installed base. We recognized revenue of $176.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2025, compared to revenue of $125.8 million and $87.2 million for the year ended December 31, 2024 and 2023, respectively. Substantially all of our revenue is generated on a "pay-per-click" basis each time a physician chooses to review either our Heartflow FFRCT Analysis, Heartflow Plaque Analysis, or both and we recognize usage-driven fee revenue upon delivery of the requested analysis to the physician. Heartflow FFRCT Analysis has served as our commercial foundation, representing 98% of our total revenue as of December 31, 2025. In the second half of 2023, we initiated limited market education efforts for Heartflow Plaque Analysis, our second commercial product, and we expect to broaden our market education efforts as payor coverage for Heartflow Plaque Analysis increases. Heartflow Plaque Analysis is currently covered by certain government and third-party payors. Our Heartflow RoadMap Analysis is generally provided as a workflow efficiency tool to drive customer retention and loyalty and is not a stand-alone product.

Prior to our IPO, we primarily funded our operations with proceeds from sales of shares of our redeemable convertible preferred stock, common stock and convertible promissory notes, borrowings under our term loans and revenue received from our customers. As of December 31, 2025, we had $280.2 million in cash and cash equivalents and investments. In January and March 2025, we issued $98.3 million in aggregate principal amount of the 2025 Convertible Notes to investors, including related parties, with original maturity dates of 48 months from the dates of issuance. The consideration for the issuance of the 2025 Convertible Notes was comprised of $74.0 million in cash, $1.3 million in aggregate principal amount of notes issued in lieu of cash compensation to certain employees, and the exchange of $23.0 million of outstanding indebtedness under the 2024 Credit Agreement (as defined below).

paragraphs: 本公司提供軟體及人工智慧（"AI"）產品，用以提供更精準且臨牀有效的無創性解決方案，用於診斷與管理冠狀動脈疾病（"CAD"），這是全球最主要的死亡原因之一。截至2025年12月31日，本公司Heartflow平台已用於評估超過600,000位患者，其中2025年單獨就有219,000位患者。本公司相信，我們是目前最廣泛採用的AI驅動的CAD診斷測試。本公司創新平台結合AI與先進的計算流體動力學技術，從單一冠狀動脈電腦斷層造影（"CCTA"）掃描，建立患者個人化的3D心臟模型，CCTA是一種特殊的掃描方式，可提供心臟動脈詳細的影像。本公司Heartflow平台提供有關血流、狹窄、斑塊體積與斑塊組成的可操作性見解，從而克服傳統無創性影像測試的限制，傳統測試依賴間接測量冠狀動脈疾病，導致較高的假陰性與假陽性率，如本公司PRECISE試驗所顯示。本公司相信Heartflow平台獨特的準確性與臨牀價值，以及其提升工作流程的能力，將持續支持本公司成長，並推進"CCTA + Heartflow"路徑成為無創性診斷與管理CAD的最終標準。

心血管疾病是全球最主要的死亡原因，其中CAD是最致命的形式。CAD發生在當斑塊（由膽固醇、脂肪、鈣質及其他物質組成的堆積）累積在冠狀動脈壁上，限制血液流動，增加心臟病發作或中風的風險。此狀況在全球造成一半的心血管相關死亡。僅美國而言，疾病管制中心（"CDC"）估計每年約有805,000人發生心臟病發作。儘管在治療與介入治療方面有顯著進步，CAD仍是全球最主要的死亡原因，因為醫療系統通常缺乏可擴展的方法，以有效檢測、診斷與量化CAD，達到個人化層面。

CCTA已成為評估CAD的首選無創性影像方法，提供冠狀動脈的直接且詳細的影像。與傳統基於壓力的無創性測試（"NITs"）不同，CCTA使醫生能夠識別冠狀動脈阻塞的現存與範圍。因此，CCTA已成為疑似CAD患者的首選一線測試，如美國心臟協會（AHA）與美國心臟學會（ACC）指南將CCTA提升至Class 1，Level A。然而，雖然CCTA提供優越的解剖影像，但它無法獨立量化CAD的嚴重程度、評估血流限制或特徵斑塊組成—這些是決定患者最適當、個人化治療方案的關鍵因素。
本公司Heartflow平台建立在CCTA已有的優勢基礎上，超越其限制，提供新的量化見解與強大的數據視覺化。透過將我們先進的AI驅動技術應用於單一CCTA掃描，我們產生精確的患者特定分析，量化血流、測量斑塊負荷並特徵化斑塊組成—在主要冠狀動脈的每個點。

Heartflow增強CCTA，這是評估CAD最先進的無創性影像技術，透過AI驅動分析，提供更精準且臨牀可操作的見解，用於診斷與管理CAD。Heartflow平台應用深度學習，一種先進的AI形式，以及計算流體動力學，對CCTA影像進行處理，建立基於單一CCTA影像的患者個人化3D心臟模型。此模型提供有關血流、狹窄、斑塊體積與斑塊組成的可操作性見解，實現精確診斷、風險分層與治療計畫—無需侵入性手術。

本公司設計的AI驅動軟體平台具備高度可擴展性，能順暢整合至現有醫生診斷CAD的工作流程，並隨著我們處理更多數據而持續改進。透過利用AI處理大量案例，並透過"人類在循環"的品質控制流程，將學習成果反饋至演算法中，以提升其效能與效率，我們已將平台擴展至能提供準確且及時的結果，使醫生與患者受益。我們的雲端技術使我們能迅速擴展至美國超過1,465個帳戶的安裝基礎。我們也建立了大量且持續增長的數據資產，推動演算法的改進已超過10年，截至2025年12月31日，我們已分析並標註超過160百萬張標註的CCTA影像。
2025年12月31日，我們已分析並標註超過160 百萬張標註的CCTA影像。此外，透過我們與客戶之間的雙向資料共享關係，我們確保平台升級，透過新功能、工作流程效率提升及性能改善，提供即時且具體的效益。
當患者出現CAD症狀，且其醫生遵循AHA與ACC Class 1，Level A胸痛指南，將患者轉介進行CCTA時，患者將在相關醫院或門診設施進行標準CCTA影像檢查。在Heartflow啟用的帳戶中，CCTA影像會透過醫院或門診影像中心內嵌的軟體，安全地傳輸至我們的雲端平台。透過專利的AI與先進的計算流體動力學技術，我們建立患者冠狀動脈的個人化、3D數位模型，解鎖標準影像無法顯示的關鍵見解。

本公司 Heartflow 平台可順暢整合至客戶的作業流程，直接提供臨牀可操作的見解至帳戶，我們認為這已足夠符合客戶的作業流程。我們會自動將 Heartflow RoadMap 分析結果傳送給影像心臟科醫師或放射科醫師，針對本公司帳戶中所有符合條件的 CCTA 病患，以協助提升 CCTA 解讀、作業流程及再血管化策略的效率。配合 Heartflow RoadMap 分析結果，我們也會為醫師提供一個病例清單，歸檔所有 CCTA 病例，並標示出哪些病例可透過 Heartflow FFRCT 分析、Heartflow Plaque 分析或兩者皆可，準確診斷臨牀顯著的 CAD 並規劃治療。醫師只需點擊一次，即可即時存取這些分析結果，並為每項選購的產品直接向帳戶收費。因為 Heartflow FFRCT 分析與 Heartflow Plaque 分析具有不同的臨牀適應症與專屬的收費碼，我們的作業流程有助於醫師為每位病患訂購最適當的分析項目，支持高品質的醫療照護與高效的費用報銷流程。
截至目前為止，本公司已在 Heartflow 平台下開發了三項軟體產品（預計於 2026 年第二季推出第四項產品），為醫師提供診斷與管理 CAD 所需的關鍵見解：

Heartflow RoadMap 分析：Heartflow RoadMap 分析根據 CCTA 影像，提供高度直覺的解剖學視覺化，顯示病患的冠狀動脈解剖結構。它能快速引導影像醫師至病患解剖結構中臨牀相關的區域，並提供預覽，以協助醫師在原生 CCTA 影像中準確、高效且一致地識別冠狀動脈的狹窄。Heartflow RoadMap 分析支持更高效的放射科作業流程，根據我們的 SMART-CT 研究，可將 CCTA 解讀時間提升 25%，並使評估醫師之間的結果一致性提高約 40%。醫師會將 Heartflow Roadmap 分析作為首選評估工具，與 CCTA 解讀結合，以決定是否訂購我們更詳細的 Heartflow FFRCT 分析或 Heartflow Plaque 分析報告。Heartflow RoadMap 分析於 2022 年 10 月獲得 FDA 批准，並於 2023 年第二季開始提供給客戶。我們通常將 Heartflow RoadMap 分析作為整合功能提供給帳戶，以提升其 CCTA 計畫的效率與一致性，且它並非獨立產品。我們認為 Heartflow RoadMap 分析為客戶帶來的效率已提升客戶忠誠度與留存率。

Heartflow FFRCT 分析：本公司旗艦產品 Heartflow FFRCT 分析，為每位病患提供個別化、互動式、三維解剖學重建的冠狀動脈結構，計算血流並識別臨牀顯著的 CAD，以決定是否需要介入，即 CAD 在主要冠狀動脈每個點的分數流動力（"FFR"）值為 0.80 或以下。FFR 透過評估在誘導壓力下的壓力差異，於 1.0（無限制）至 0.0（完全阻塞）的範圍內衡量冠狀動脈血流限制的嚴重程度，以指導是否需要進行侵入性再血管化決策。

該模型沿血管長度以顏色編碼，顯示 Heartflow FFRCT 分析的值，協助醫師快速且精準地評估冠狀動脈的血流。我們的 Heartflow FFRCT 分析為非侵入性 CAD 測試中診斷準確度最高的產品，並在 PRECISE、NXT 與 PACIFIC 研究中顯示與侵入性 FFR 高度一致。我們的產品可測量 FFR 值並判斷病變是否為臨牀顯著 – 一個 "臨牀顯著病變" 指的是 FFR 值為 0.80 或以下。因為 FFR 值是用來決定是否需要進行侵入性再血管化的指南導向測量，這些數據提供了更臨牀準確的非侵入性基礎，以決定是否需要進行介入性治療。

目前 AHA 和 ACC 指南支持 CCTA + Heartflow FFRCT 分析作為更高效的照護路徑。指南將 CCTA 指定為 CAD 在某些穩定或急性胸痛且無已知 CAD 的病患中為 Class 1、Level A 測試，並給予 Heartflow FFRCT 分析 Class 2a、Level B 的認可，以協助醫師指導病患治療決策。此 CCTA + Heartflow FFRCT 分析路徑使醫師能在少於兩小時內識別需要再血管化的病變，且指南建議具有正面 Heartflow FFRCT 分析結果的病患應直接送往心導管實驗室進行可能的治療。相較之下，AHA 和 ACC 指南對基於壓力的測試給予 Class 1、Level B 的建議，建議具有疑似 CAD 且壓力測試結果為陽性的病患首先開始指南導向的醫療治療。只有在醫療治療無法緩解症狀，且可能持續數週或數個月後，病患才會被送往心導管實驗室。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之分析與討論，並配合我們合併財務報表及相關附註與其他財務資訊，這些資訊包含於本年度報告中。本討論與分析以及本年度報告之其他部分包含前瞻性陳述，這些陳述基於我們目前的計畫與預期，涉及風險、不確定性與假設，例如關於我們計畫、目標、預期、意圖與信念之陳述。我們實際結果與事件的時間點可能與這些前瞻性陳述所預期的有重大差異，原因可能是多種因素，包括於「風險因素」節中所列舉的，以及本年度報告其他地方所提及的。您應仔細閱讀「風險因素」節，以瞭解可能導致實際結果與我們前瞻性陳述有重大差異的重要因素。請同時參閱「關於前瞻性陳述之特別說明」節。

本年度報告表10-K之此節通常討論2025年與2024年項目及2025年與2024年之間的年對年比較。未包含於本表10-K中的2023年項目及2024年與2023年之間的年對年比較，可於本年度報告中「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之分析」節找到，該節為2024年12月31日結業年度之財務狀況與營運成果分析，包含於我們於表S-1（檔案編號333-288733）之註冊聲明中，該註冊聲明於2025年8月7日生效。

我們提供軟體與人工智慧（"AI"），旨在提供更準確且臨牀有效的非侵入式解決方案，用以診斷與管理冠狀動脈疾病（"CAD"），這是全球主要的死亡原因。截至2025年12月31日，我們的Heartflow平台已用於評估CAD的患者超過600,000人，其中2025年單獨就有219,000人。我們相信我們是目前最廣泛採用的AI驅動的CAD測試。我們的創新平台利用AI與先進的計算流體動力學技術，從單一冠狀電腦斷層掃描血管造影（"CCTA"）建立患者的個人化3D心臟模型，CCTA是一種專門的掃描，可提供心臟動脈的詳細影像。我們的Heartflow平台提供有關血流、狹窄、斑塊體積與斑塊組成的可操作見解，從而克服傳統非侵入式影像測試的限制，這些測試依賴間接測量冠狀動脈疾病，導致較高的假陰性與假陽性率，如我們的PRECISE試驗所顯示。我們相信Heartflow平台的差異化準確性與臨牀價值，以及其提升工作流程的能力，將持續支持我們的成長，並促進"CCTA + Heartflow"路徑成為非侵入式診斷與管理CAD的確定標準。
截至目前為止，我們已在Heartflow平台下開發了三種軟體產品（預計於2026年第二季推出第四種產品），為醫師提供診斷與管理CAD所需的關鍵見解：
•Heartflow RoadMap Analysis提供高度直觀的冠狀動脈解剖影像，協助醫師快速識別臨牀上重要的區域以進行審視。我們將Heartflow RoadMap Analysis作為整合功能提供給客戶，以提升其CCTA計畫的效率，且此產品非獨立產品。
•Heartflow FFRCT Analysis計算血流並識別臨牀上重要的CAD，即在主要冠狀動脈每一個點上，具有分數流量儲備（"FFR"）值為0.80或以下的CAD。FFR透過評估壓力差異來衡量冠狀動脈血流限制的嚴重程度，其評分範圍為1.0（無限制）至0.0（完全阻塞），指導醫師是否需要對患者進行侵入式再血管化手術的決定。
•Heartflow Plaque Analysis提供冠狀動脈斑塊的全面評估，使醫療治療策略得以最佳化。
•Heartflow PCI Navigator，我們預計於2026年第二季推出，將提供進階的影像與臨牀見解，以最佳化再血管化策略、指導裝置選擇、提升手術效率並改善患者照護。我們計畫將Heartflow PCI Navigator作為整合功能提供給客戶以提升手術效率，而非作為獨立產品。
我們預期於2027年推出Plaque Tracker，這是我們的第五款產品。Plaque Tracker將能進行連續CCTA的縱向斑塊分析，以根據斑塊逆轉來衡量醫療治療的效果。
Heartflow平台已在美國、英國、歐盟及日本擁有現有的商業佈局與法規認可。此外，我們的部分或全部平台已獲得加拿大、澳洲、以色列、沙烏地阿拉伯及阿拉伯聯合大公國與巴林的醫療器材許可或認可。
我們已發展出一個高度可擴展且資本效率高的商業模式，結合地區銷售經理（"TSMs"）推動新客戶採用，以及地區客戶經理（"TAMs"）專注於透過教育轉診醫師來提高使用率。我們的商業團隊不處理病例，也不會花費時間在手術室或實驗室環境中，這使他們能專注於推動商業採用與教育活動。我們也在國際市場擁有小型的直接商業團隊。未來，我們可能擴展國際佈局至這些市場以外的地區。
我們的技術簡單且直覺化，不需購買任何資本設備。我們的上手流程能順暢地將Heartflow平台整合至客戶的日常作業流程中。這些獨特的商業模式特質，使我們的商業團隊擁有區別化的效率與可擴展性。

在我們IPO之前，我們主要透過銷售我們可贖回轉換優先股、普通股及轉換票據的資金，以及透過我們的長期貸款取得的貸款以及來自客戶的收入來資助營運。截至2025年12月31日，我們持有280.2 百萬美元的現金及現金等價物與投資。在2025年1月及3月，我們向投資者發行了總計98.3 百萬美元的2025年轉換票據，包括相關當事人，其原始到期日為發行日後48個月。發行2025年轉換票據的對價包含74.0 百萬美元現金、1.3 百萬美元總計本金金額的票據，作為對某些員工現金補償的替代，以及將23.0 百萬美元的2024年信貸協議（如下所定義）下的現有債務進行交換。
